name: Oliver's mTOR Atlas API
description: Read-only, static JSON access to the curated corpus of Oliver's mTOR Atlas: studies labelled by the kind of study behind them, entities, evidence-linked pathway relations and open questions. The same data that builds the website.
cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

evidence_codes.label: Review — secondary literature, not a new result

evidence_note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality
limits: Static files: no query parameters, no authentication, no rate limit. Download a list endpoint and filter locally. Responses carry ETag/Last-Modified from the host.
